description: This Dart source file defines an ApiClient class that wraps HTTP calls to a backend API, handling authentication, request formation, response parsing, and error handling. It includes methods for login and fetching user info, utilizing environment variables for configuration.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with the backend API, including login and user info retrieval, managing HTTP requests and handling environment configurations.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HTTP client, optionally with a custom client.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Getter that retrieves the backend URL from environment variables.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Helper method to construct a full URI from a path.

methods.name: _jsonHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers for JSON requests, optionally including an authorization token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with email and password, returning an access token.

methods.name: getMe
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile information using the provided token.

methods.name: _readErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses error messages from HTTP responses.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the HTTP client when no longer needed.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Exception class representing errors from API calls, including optional HTTP status code and response body.
